discoverySummary.deloitteOutcome: Deloitte: no verified eligible new opening today. Deloitte India, USI and South Asia were searched first; no new exact requisition simultaneously established current application access and zero-experience eligibility.
heldReview: Deloitte results were generic, blocked or lacked conclusive current fresher eligibility; retained as REVIEW rather than Expired.
NVIDIA Workday internship pages returned empty public shells during final verification; held as REVIEW.
Several official pages with crawler-only evidence, redirects or conflicting eligibility were held instead of being staged.
expiredSignals: Adobe R173016 displayed an authoritative filled notice and was excluded.
Google internships with a 23 Oct 2026 deadline and American Express apprenticeships with a 23 Oct 2026 deadline were excluded after the deadline passed.
discoverySummary.note: Fresh 24 Oct discovery. Current published jobs, active batch, archived review batches, VIP request, Telegram queue and delivery ledger were checked. One employer appears once across Priority and Backup. Only exact Live, source-complete candidates were persisted.

ranking.policy: Zero-experience or current-student eligibility, exact current application evidence, Deloitte/watchlist priority, usefulness, source completeness and one employer per combined batch.
